entities.summary: Ayatollah Sayyid Mohammad-Ali Mousavi Jazayeri is an Iranian Twelver Shia cleric, who was the representative of Vali-Faqih in Khuzestan province from 1983 to 2019. He was elected by the order of Sayyid Ruhollah Khomeini, who was the previous Supreme Leader of Iran.
